messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, the other day I got
this letter from
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 16 00}But I kept forgetting to
write back. Or maybe I was
just too lazy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 03 00}Har har! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}Anyway, can you do
me a favor and deliver this
letter, {04 1f 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii, hiljuti sain ma
selle kirja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} käest...
{07 16 00}Aga ma unustasin aina
vastata. Või ehk olin ma
lihtsalt laisk, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 03 00}Har har! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}Igatahes, kas sa
teeksid teene ja viiksid
selle kirja, {04 1f 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} you
gotta do me a favor,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
I completely forgot that I
had to send {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}
a letter.
{07 16 00}If I ask {ff 00 00 06}Petey{ff 00 00 00} to deliver
it, who knows when he'll get
around to it!
{07 14 00}So I need you to deliver
the letter for me by hand,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} sa
pead mulle teene tegema,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Ma unustasin täiesti, et
pean tüübile nimega
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} kirja saatma.
{07 16 00}Kui ma palun {ff 00 00 06}Peteyl{ff 00 00 00} seda
viia, kes teab, millal ta
selleni jõuab!
{07 14 00}Nii et sa pead kirja
minu eest käsitsi viima,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
